message:
The other day, I was rummaging through my closet looking for my favorite sweater when I stumbled upon our family go-bags, tucked away in the corner. I had completely forgotten about them! It made me chuckle, thinking about how I had packed them with the best intentions—snacks, a flashlight, and even a few games for the kids. But there they sat, gathering dust, while I was contemplating what to wear for a chilly afternoon. 

It reminded me how easy it is to get caught up in daily life and forget our little preparations. Sometimes, the best plans are the ones we don’t take too seriously. Have you checked your go-bags lately?
